messages:
Nora (PM): Quick sync 12: We're finalizing the 'cutover credits' and short-pin workflow for customers who opt into assisted migrations. Need clear ACs so sales/legal can ship a checkbox flow.

Marcus (Sales): Customers want low-friction opt-in. Proposed: checkbox in console + emailed consent. Offer migration credit (25% of monthly bill for 2 months) if they choose assisted migration and complete within 45 days.

Priya (ML): If embed dims or tokenizer changes, assisted migration must include an adapter and an eval drift report. We should require an eval checksum and post-migration cosine drift <0.03.

Ethan (Eng): Tech constraints: console opt-in must write a consent record with timestamp and ticket ID. Assisted migration requires a compat_tag and either an auto-adapter or a manual-hours estimate. If complexity score >7 -> require named eng lead.

Zoe (SRE): Ops requirements: during cutover we need a 4h rollback window with auto-switchback, ramp policy (1%->10%->50% over 48h), and alerts: token-cost delta >25% over 1h, p95 >30% increase over 30m. Enable 60d telemetry retention for assisted migrations.

consent-bot: Created ticket #9802 "cutover-credits-optin" https://redwood/tickets/9802

Nora (PM): Draft ACs: 1) console opt-in + persisted consent; 2) credits manifest and expiration; 3) compat_tag + eval checksum; 4) migration-adapter or hours estimate; 5) rollback SLA and canary ramp. Owners: Ethan -> consent flow + schema, Priya -> eval template, Zoe -> rollback/runbook, Marcus -> commercial terms.

Marcus (Sales): Also request an "early-adopter" bonus: extra credits if migration completes within 21 days. Keep amount configurable.

Ethan (Eng): We'll surface a migration_complexity score on ingest and fail if compat_tag missing. Console will prevent opt-in until required fields present.

Nora (PM): Thanks all. I'll update #9802 with the ACs and schedule a 30m working session Thursday 10am to finalize wording for legal. :thumbsup:
